scenarios.title: Cover the defender who steps
scenarios.coordination: H_LB pressures A_RW; H_CB covers inside and tracks A_ST; H_RB narrows; H_DM screens the backward-central outlet.

source_sections.S1: Key coaching points; Exercise 1 coaching points

scenarios.cue: LB engages a winger; an inside runner threatens behind LB.
scenarios.preferred_decision: give inside/deeper cover while monitoring the runner.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: engage only after responsibility transfers and cover exists.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “One pressed; you protected what was behind.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: LB is beaten; CB must now reassess becoming first defender.
scenarios.correction: One centre-back only; cover cannot abandon A_ST to double-team A_RW.

scenarios.title: Support a coordinated press
scenarios.coordination: H_ST pressures A_CB; wings restrict respective outside backs; H_CM screens A_DM; H_DM monitors A_CM; back three track depth.
scenarios.cue: front line presses a back-facing receiver; midfield follows; CB is detached.
scenarios.preferred_decision: advance with the connected unit while tracking depth threats.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: hold/drop if the ball carrier can release behind or cover is absent.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your line supported the press because pressure limited the next pass.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: opponent turns freely; automatic stepping becomes unsafe.
scenarios.correction: Step only while pressure restricts the forward ball; opponent's turn reverses the recommendation.

scenarios.title: Protect the centre on turnover
scenarios.coordination: H_CM has lost possession; H_CB delays A_CM and protects A_ST's route; H_DM recovers goal-side; outside backs recover.
scenarios.cue: 8 loses possession; CB faces ball carrier and a separate runner.
scenarios.preferred_decision: delay and protect the central route until support returns.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: intercept a clearly exposed pass.
scenarios.misconception: chase wide and open the route to goal.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “You bought time while keeping the dangerous route closed.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: support arrives; assess whether pressure can increase.
scenarios.correction: Specify which runner is dangerous; do not prescribe an automatic tackle or chase.

scenarios.title: Find the dropping midfielder
scenarios.coordination: A_ST obstructs H_CB to H_ST; H_DM offers a reachable outlet beyond pressure; H_CM stays separate; outside backs provide alternatives.
scenarios.cue: 6 drops into a clear lane; forward pressure prevents a safe direct ball to 9.
scenarios.preferred_decision: connect through 6.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: use the wide outlet if 6 is followed.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Find the available connection.”
scenarios.correction: Replace source's two centre-backs with this back-three map; no neutral receiver.

scenarios.title: Pass into a receiving window
scenarios.coordination: H_CM drifts into the gap between A_DM and A_CB; H_DM and H_RB remain other outlets; A_ST threatens the passing window.

source_sections.S13: Methodology: practice type; Key coaching points

scenarios.cue: 8 drifts between lines into a visible passing window.
scenarios.preferred_decision: deliver while the window is open.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: retain if an opponent closes it.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Recognize the window.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: close the window before the passer's first contact. Limitation: the source is unopposed; opposed answer validity needs separate review.
scenarios.correction: Add S8 opposed guidance to S13 technique; require a viable receiver first touch, not just an apparently clear line.

scenarios.title: Take over when cover becomes pressure
scenarios.coordination: A_RW has beaten H_LB; H_CB takes over delay; H_RB covers A_ST; H_DM protects the inside lane; H_LB recovers.

source_sections.S1: Key coaching points; Exercise 1 coaching points

scenarios.cue: LB is beaten; CB can confront the carrier while RB covers depth.
scenarios.preferred_decision: take over pressure with controlled approach.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: delay centrally when the runner prevents safe engagement.
scenarios.misconception: remain passive solely because the original job was cover.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your responsibility changed when the first defender was beaten.”
scenarios.correction: Switch pressure/cover only after role transfer; remove H_RB cover in counterfactual.

scenarios.title: Escape a touchline trap
scenarios.coordination: A_RW presses H_LB and A_CM closes forward play; H_DM offers inside; H_CB offers recycle; H_LW offers depth.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: receiving left, forward route blocked, 6 visible inside.
scenarios.preferred_decision: combine inside.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: recycle to CB if 6 is screened.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your support gave you another direction.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: mark 6 and open the line pass instead.
scenarios.correction: Pass inside only if H_DM has a usable next action; touchline is a real boundary.

scenarios.title: Decide whether to jump
scenarios.coordination: H_LB approaches back-facing A_RW; H_LW limits return to A_RB; H_CB covers A_ST; H_RB narrows; H_DM screens inside.
scenarios.cue: opponent receives left with back turned; CB covers and LW screens return.
scenarios.preferred_decision: press under that support.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: delay if CB is occupied by a runner.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “The support behind you made that press possible.”
scenarios.correction: Back turned alone is insufficient; approach must arrive before receiver can exploit behind.

scenarios.title: Recover inside first
scenarios.coordination: A_LW carries on home right; H_RB delays; H_CB is drawn across; H_LB protects A_ST centrally while checking A_RW.
scenarios.cue: ball lost on the opposite flank; a central runner is more dangerous than a distant wide player.
scenarios.preferred_decision: recover toward the central threat while scanning wide.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: track the wide runner if the central zone is already covered.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Recover toward the danger, not just your starting spot.”
scenarios.correction: Home left and opponent right are not screen-left labels; threat changes determine recovery.

scenarios.title: Overlap when width opens
scenarios.coordination: H_LB overlaps outside H_LW; H_CB shifts left; H_RB tucks; H_DM remains underneath; H_CM does not also vacate balance.

source_sections.S10: Part 3 variations 2–3; Part 4 organization and variation

scenarios.cue: LW moves inside; outside lane and defensive balance are available.
scenarios.preferred_decision: time an overlap.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: support behind if the lane is closed.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Use complementary movement.”
scenarios.correction: Replace four-back assumptions. If H_RB is already advanced or H_DM cannot screen A_ST, hold instead.

scenarios.title: Deliver to the available receiver
scenarios.coordination: H_LB delivers from left; H_ST is arriving; H_LW is inside but separate; H_CM supports cutback; H_CB H_RB H_DM protect transition.

source_sections.S12: Part 3 explanation and coaching points ONLY

scenarios.cue: wide possession; an early delivery lane and arriving teammate are visible.
scenarios.preferred_decision: serve that arrival.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: advance for a cutback if early delivery is blocked.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Match the delivery to support.”
scenarios.correction: No neutral wide player or cross-only scoring. Show receiver, delivery path and opponent goalkeeper.

scenarios.title: Do not follow a broken press blindly
scenarios.coordination: H_LW's press has been bypassed to A_RW; H_CB is occupied by A_ST; H_LB recovers rather than jumping alone.
scenarios.cue: opponents bypass the first press; teammate cannot cover LB stepping forward.
scenarios.preferred_decision: recover into a connected defensive position.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: press if the next receiver is trapped and cover returns.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Reconnect before committing again.”
scenarios.correction: Define broken press as an actual completed bypass, not a generic animation cue.

scenarios.title: Escape a touchline trap
scenarios.coordination: A_LW presses H_RB; A_CM closes forward play; H_DM supports inside; H_CB recycles; H_RW offers depth.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: receiving right, line blocked, 6 visible inside.
scenarios.preferred_decision: combine inside.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: recycle to CB if screened.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “You found support before the touchline trapped you.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: mark 6 and open RW. Mirror LB01 spatially, not by swapping text alone.
scenarios.correction: Mirror LB01 coordinates and facing; verify inside receiver is not facing an immediate trap.

scenarios.title: Decide whether to jump
scenarios.coordination: H_RB approaches back-facing A_LW; H_RW limits return to A_LB; H_CB covers A_ST; H_LB narrows; H_DM screens.
scenarios.cue: right-side receiver faces backward; CB covers, RW screens return.
scenarios.preferred_decision: press.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: hold if a runner removes CB cover.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Pressure works when the next defender protects you.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: receiver opens toward goal. Mirror LB02 with body orientation preserved.
scenarios.correction: Mirror pressure timing and cover, not merely left/right labels.

scenarios.title: Recover inside first
scenarios.coordination: A_RW carries on home left; H_LB delays; H_CB shifts across; H_RB protects A_ST while checking A_LW.
scenarios.cue: loss on the left; an uncovered central runner threatens.
scenarios.preferred_decision: narrow and recover to protect that route.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: stay with a wide threat when centre is secure.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “You protected the route the opponent could exploit next.”
scenarios.correction: Recovery route is threat-led; do not glue the outside back to the touchline.

scenarios.title: Support the inside-moving winger
scenarios.coordination: H_RB overlaps H_RW; H_CB shifts right; H_LB tucks; H_DM stays underneath; H_CM preserves support.

source_sections.S10: Part 3 variations 2–3; Part 4 organization and variation

scenarios.cue: RW narrows and outside space is free; teammates protect transition.
scenarios.preferred_decision: overlap with usable timing.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: remain underneath if RW stays wide.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your movement offered another route.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: RW holds the touchline. Mirror-family LB04; not a new principle.
scenarios.correction: Only one outside back overlaps in this authored scene; absence of balance makes holding valid.

scenarios.title: Early service or byline
scenarios.coordination: A_LB blocks early service; H_RB can carry to byline; H_CM arrives behind H_ST; H_CB H_LB H_DM provide balance.

source_sections.S12: Part 3 explanation and coaching points ONLY

scenarios.cue: early cross is blocked but byline space and a cutback receiver are available.
scenarios.preferred_decision: advance for the cutback.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: recycle if the route closes.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “The open route changed the delivery.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: defender closes byline but opens early service.
scenarios.correction: Byline path must be genuinely reachable; if A_LB can close it, recycling is acceptable.

scenarios.title: Balance the opposite-side press
scenarios.coordination: H_LW pressures A_RB on home left; H_RB narrows with H_CB while monitoring A_LW; H_RW can recover toward A_LB.
scenarios.cue: team presses left; RB is detached on the far touchline and central spacing is stretched.
scenarios.preferred_decision: shift with the unit while monitoring the wide threat.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: retain width if the immediate switch requires it and central cover is secure.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Stay connected without losing the far threat.”
scenarios.correction: Do not screen a fast weak-side switch out of view; re-evaluate if passer gains time.

scenarios.title: Become available behind pressure
scenarios.coordination: A_ST hides H_DM from H_CB; H_DM moves laterally; H_CM stays in a different lane; H_RB is a fallback.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: CB has possession; 6 is directly behind an opponent from the ball's perspective.
scenarios.preferred_decision: move laterally into a usable passing angle, scanning before receiving.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: clear the lane for 8 when followed.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “A small movement made you visible.”
scenarios.correction: Being visible is not enough: ensure reception space; followed movement can clear H_CM instead.

scenarios.title: Cover rather than duplicate pressure
scenarios.coordination: H_CM pressures A_CM; H_DM blocks the pass to A_ST; H_CB protects depth.

source_sections.S1: Key coaching points; Exercise 1 coaching points

scenarios.cue: 8 presses ball; pass into striker remains open behind.
scenarios.preferred_decision: screen the striker route.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: take over pressure if 8 is beaten and cover transfers.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your job was the next pass, not the same opponent.”
scenarios.correction: H_DM screens one named route, not every possible central pass.

scenarios.title: Reconnect on regain
scenarios.coordination: H_DM regains back to goal under A_CM pressure; H_CB supports with a safe lane; H_CM and wings spread.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: regain facing own goal with immediate pressure and a free supporting CB.
scenarios.preferred_decision: secure possession through support.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: turn forward if scan confirms space.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Winning it did not mean the forward pass was ready.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: remove pressure and reveal a progressive lane.
scenarios.correction: S3 only supports transition context; S5 supports combining. Do not infer always-pass-back.

scenarios.title: Drop at the right moment
scenarios.coordination: H_DM drops to a new angle outside A_CM reach; H_CM stays higher; H_RB offers another direction.
scenarios.cue: CB needs a connection; 6 can drop beyond the presser's reach.
scenarios.preferred_decision: offer the timed passing angle.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: stay higher if dropping only duplicates another receiver.
scenarios.misconception: arrive alongside CB without creating a new lane.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Offer a useful connection.”
scenarios.correction: No imported neutral player, second centre-back or artificial third-line offside boundary.

scenarios.title: Release the third player
scenarios.coordination: H_ST has laid off to H_DM; H_CM runs beyond A_DM; H_CB and outside backs protect behind H_DM.
scenarios.cue: 6 receives a layoff; 8's forward run opens the next pass.
scenarios.preferred_decision: release 8 while the lane is available.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: secure possession if the runner is covered.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “The third player was the forward option.”
scenarios.correction: At the freeze the ball is with H_DM, not simultaneously with H_ST; defender reach determines release.

scenarios.title: Screen the next threat after regain is lost
scenarios.coordination: A_DM wins the ball immediately after home regain; H_CM pressures; H_DM screens A_ST; H_CB protects depth.
scenarios.cue: immediate re-loss; 8 pressures the ball, central receiver behind 8 is free.
scenarios.preferred_decision: recover to disrupt that forward connection.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: challenge the loose ball if clearly reachable first and cover exists.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Protect the pass that would break the recovery.”
scenarios.correction: Keep two possession changes in event order; no free teleport of recovery players.

scenarios.title: Receive or bounce
scenarios.coordination: H_CM receives under A_DM pressure; H_DM is the bounce outlet; H_ST occupies A_CB.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: pass arrives between opponents; pressure is tight behind and a support player is free.
scenarios.preferred_decision: lay off and move.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: turn if pressure has withdrawn and space is confirmed.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your scan decided whether the turn was available.”
scenarios.correction: Only prefer a bounce when its lane and first-touch timing are viable; turn remains valid if pressure leaves.

scenarios.title: Support the front press
scenarios.coordination: H_ST pressures A_CB; H_CM screens A_DM; H_DM monitors A_CM; wings restrict outside outlets; H_CB protects depth.
scenarios.cue: 9 presses a backward-facing CB; opposing 6 offers the inside escape.
scenarios.preferred_decision: close that receiving lane while staying connected.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: hold deeper if the frontline press is unsupported.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “You helped the press by removing the exit.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: opposing 6 moves to create a different lane.
scenarios.correction: Two home midfielders, not a hidden midfield three; H_CM cannot press CB and mark DM simultaneously.

scenarios.title: Choose a supporting lane
scenarios.coordination: H_RW carries against A_LB; H_ST occupies the direct forward lane; H_CM offers underneath outside A_DM cover; H_DM balances.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: RW has ball, 9 occupies the direct forward lane, underneath support is missing.
scenarios.preferred_decision: offer a separate backward-diagonal angle.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: run beyond if support already exists and space opens.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Different angles gave the winger different choices.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: add underneath support and open depth.
scenarios.correction: New support must create a distinct passing angle; don't reward standing on H_ST's line.

scenarios.title: Progress when the line holds
scenarios.coordination: H_CM has received facing forward beyond A_DM; A_CB holds; H_ST and wings occupy distinct lanes; H_DM supports.
scenarios.cue: 8 receives facing forward between lines; defenders hold and carrying space is clear.
scenarios.preferred_decision: advance to engage them.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: pass when a defender steps and frees a teammate.
scenarios.misconception: run into pressure after the picture changes.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Use space, then reassess.”
scenarios.correction: Carrying is conditional on available space and controllable ball, not a universal forward command.

scenarios.title: Be the third-player runner
scenarios.coordination: H_ST can lay off to H_DM; H_CM begins a legal run beyond A_DM; back three remain behind H_DM.
scenarios.cue: 9 can bounce the ball to 6; a separate forward lane opens for 8.
scenarios.preferred_decision: time a run for the next pass.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: support underneath if that lane closes.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your movement completed the connection.”
scenarios.correction: Freeze precedes layoff; this is a different decision instant from DM05 and ST04, not three simultaneous balls.

scenarios.title: Arrive for the cutback
scenarios.coordination: H_RW reaches byline; H_ST is nearer goal; H_CM offers the backward lane; H_LW stays separate; H_DM holds balance.

source_sections.S12: Part 3 explanation and coaching points ONLY

scenarios.cue: winger reaches byline; defenders protect the goalmouth, leaving a backward lane to 8.
scenarios.preferred_decision: offer that lane without crowding 9.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: hold balance when another teammate occupies it.
scenarios.misconception: join every attacker at the near post.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Offer a different finishing angle.”
scenarios.correction: Only one central midfielder joins the box here; no added number 10 or second number 8.

scenarios.title: Combine against a second defender
scenarios.coordination: A_RB engages H_LW; A_DM closes as cover; H_LB offers support; H_CM and H_ST stay distinct.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: receiving left, second opponent closes, LB support remains open.
scenarios.preferred_decision: combine with support.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: beat the first defender if the second is too far to cover.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “The second defender changed the decision.”
scenarios.correction: Show whether the second defender arrives in time; do not penalize a feasible 1v1 solely by headcount.

scenarios.title: Close the outlet in the press
scenarios.coordination: H_ST pressures A_CB; H_LW restricts A_RB; H_CM screens A_DM; H_LB monitors A_RW with H_CB cover.
scenarios.cue: 9 pressures CB and opposing RB becomes the available escape.
scenarios.preferred_decision: position to restrict that outlet while retaining team connection.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: recover inside if the press is broken.
scenarios.misconception: sprint at the ball and free RB.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “You pressed the passing option as well as the ball.”
scenarios.correction: Restrict outlet by angle and timing; no assumption that all passes are automatically closed.

scenarios.title: Time the run
scenarios.coordination: H_CM prepares a ground pass to H_LW; H_ST offers another lane; show the defensive line and ball at contact.
scenarios.cue: in opponent half, passer preparing release, winger near the second-last-opponent line.
scenarios.preferred_decision: delay/curve to remain legally positioned at the relevant contact.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: check short.
scenarios.misconception: leave early and become involved from offside.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your starting position mattered when the ball was played.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: defender drops or ball is ahead of winger.
scenarios.correction: Offside depends on ball AND second-last opponent; level is eligible; own half uses real pitch halfway.

scenarios.title: Make space for the overlap
scenarios.coordination: H_LB overlaps; H_LW moves inside only into free space; H_CM avoids that pocket; H_DM H_CB H_RB balance.

source_sections.S10: Part 3 variations 2–3; Part 4 organization and variation

scenarios.cue: LB overlaps; LW can draw a defender inside without obstructing a teammate.
scenarios.preferred_decision: move inside and assess the release.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: stay wide if LB remains behind.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your movement helped the overlap.”
scenarios.correction: Show the overlap and its cover, not a compulsory winger-inside script.

scenarios.title: Reach the delivery, not the position early
scenarios.coordination: H_RW prepares delivery; H_ST uses near-side route; H_LW times far-side arrival; H_CM supports edge and H_DM stays behind.
scenarios.cue: ball travels to RW for a cross; far-side space is available.
scenarios.preferred_decision: time an arrival into that space.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: hold/reposition if delivery is delayed.
scenarios.misconception: arrive too early and become static or offside.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Arrive with the delivery.”
scenarios.correction: Do not use head-height delivery by default; offside checked on the crosser's relevant contact.

scenarios.title: Select the cutback target
scenarios.coordination: H_LW at byline sees H_CM arriving behind H_ST; H_RW is separate; H_DM H_CB H_RB balance.

source_sections.S12: Part 3 explanation and coaching points ONLY

scenarios.cue: byline possession; near-goal lane blocked, trailing 8 available.
scenarios.preferred_decision: pass backward toward 8's usable space.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: recycle if that lane closes.
scenarios.misconception: hit a blind ball across defenders.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Find the teammate the defence left.”
scenarios.correction: Cutback is not always best: receiver readiness and A_DM interception reach must be visible.

scenarios.title: Combine against a second defender
scenarios.coordination: A_LB engages H_RW; A_DM covers; H_RB supports; H_CM and H_ST keep separate options.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: on right, second defender closes, RB offers support.
scenarios.preferred_decision: combine.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: attack isolated first defender if cover is absent.
scenarios.misconception: force the same dribble despite cover.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Read the covering defender before committing.”
scenarios.correction: Mirror LW01 with preserved pressure and foot orientation.

scenarios.title: Close the outlet in the press
scenarios.coordination: H_ST pressures A_CB; H_RW restricts A_LB; H_CM screens A_DM; H_RB monitors A_LW with H_CB cover.
scenarios.cue: 9 presses CB; opposing LB offers escape.
scenarios.preferred_decision: restrict that outlet in connection with teammates.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: recover inside once bypassed.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your position made their next pass harder.”
scenarios.correction: Use opponent's left back on home right; never confuse jersey number with role.

scenarios.title: Time the run
scenarios.coordination: H_CM prepares a ground pass to H_RW; H_ST occupies another lane; show ball and defensive line.
scenarios.cue: right winger near offside line in opposing half as teammate prepares pass.
scenarios.preferred_decision: time/curve the run from a legal position.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: offer short support.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “The run and the pass had to work together.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: defender drops; recalculate rather than reuse answer. Mirror LW03.
scenarios.correction: Mirror LW03 legally and spatially; include omitted opponents in second-last-opponent calculation.

scenarios.title: Keep width until it serves a purpose
scenarios.coordination: H_CM has no viable central penetration; H_RW offers width outside A_LB; H_RB remains underneath; H_DM balances.

source_sections.S12: Part 3 explanation and coaching points ONLY

scenarios.cue: central route congested; RW provides an accessible wide outlet.
scenarios.preferred_decision: retain useful width to receive.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: move inside when a fullback supplies width and the inside lane opens.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your width offered a route around.”
scenarios.correction: Source is mixed-format; use only Part 3 delivery/support concepts, not Part 4 11v11 organization.

scenarios.title: Attack the far-side delivery
scenarios.coordination: H_LW prepares delivery; H_ST chooses near-side route; H_RW offers far side; H_CM supports edge, H_DM holds.
scenarios.cue: LW prepares a cross; 9 attacks a different zone.
scenarios.preferred_decision: time a run into the free far-side zone.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: adjust if delivery is delayed.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Give the passer distinct targets.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: a defender closes that zone. Mirror-family LW05.
scenarios.correction: Mirror LW05; forbid copying two winger cards into one scene as extra players.

scenarios.title: Do not cross just because you are wide
scenarios.coordination: A_CB and A_RB cover H_ST and H_LW; A_LB pressures H_RW; H_RB is safe support; H_DM holds.

source_sections.S12: Part 3 explanation and coaching points ONLY

scenarios.cue: wide possession; both forward receivers covered, backward support free.
scenarios.preferred_decision: recycle and reset the attack.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: deliver when a receiver separates and the lane opens.
scenarios.misconception: force service into a crowded area.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Wait for a usable target.”
scenarios.correction: Reject blind service, but do not reject a newly opened dribble or shot; S12 strengthens receiver-selection evidence.

scenarios.title: Hold, lay off or turn
scenarios.coordination: H_ST receives back to goal under A_CB pressure; H_CM is free of A_DM; wingers maintain depth.

source_sections.S5: Skill development: 1v1 to 1v2 with support players

scenarios.cue: receiving back to goal with tight pressure and 8 available.
scenarios.preferred_decision: protect and lay off.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: turn if the defender's position and available space genuinely allow it.
scenarios.misconception: assume proximity alone makes turning correct.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “You kept the next action available for the team.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: defender backs away and a turning lane opens.
scenarios.correction: Close defender does not automatically permit turning; show actual escape side and ball control.

scenarios.title: Initiate only a supported press
scenarios.coordination: A_CB receives facing own goal; H_ST can arrive; wings restrict outside backs; H_CM screens A_DM; H_DM covers A_CM.
scenarios.cue: backward reception, winger and 8 ready to close exits.
scenarios.preferred_decision: initiate coordinated pressure.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: screen and wait if teammates are detached.
scenarios.misconception: sprint alone and allow an easy bypass.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “The trigger mattered because your teammates could support it.”
scenarios.correction: No four-back opponent or extra midfielder imported. Abandon press if arrival/support condition fails.

scenarios.title: Adjust rather than wait offside
scenarios.coordination: H_ST is beyond ball and second-last opponent in opponent half before H_CM plays; H_LW offers another route.
scenarios.cue: striker in the opposing half, beyond both the ball and second-last opponent, teammate not yet playing the ball.
scenarios.preferred_decision: return to an eligible position before the relevant pass contact or offer a different run.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: remain uninvolved while another teammate plays, without interfering.
scenarios.misconception: receive after merely stepping back following release and assume legality is restored.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Coming back after the pass did not erase the earlier position.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: begin in own half; apply the correct rule.
scenarios.correction: Add missing ball condition. Returning after contact does not cure that phase; a later phase requires fresh assessment.

scenarios.title: Bounce for the third-player route
scenarios.coordination: H_ST receives against A_CB; H_DM supports; H_CM runs beyond A_DM; home back three retain balance.
scenarios.cue: 9 receives under pressure; 6 supports and 8 runs beyond.
scenarios.preferred_decision: lay off to enable 6's forward pass.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: turn if pressure withdraws and space is confirmed.
scenarios.misconception: insist on turning into the marker.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Your pass opened someone else's route.”
scenarios.correction: A third-player pattern is an option, not an enforced three-pass reward; compare direct turn when available.

scenarios.title: Match the cross with the run
scenarios.coordination: H_RW can deliver early behind A_CB; H_ST runs onside into reachable space; H_LW offers a distinct route.
scenarios.cue: early wide delivery is available behind the defensive line.
scenarios.preferred_decision: time an onside run into its reachable path.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: delay when the crosser is blocked.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Synchronize the run and service.”
scenarios.changed_cue_test: delay the ball; reassess offside at the passer's first contact.
scenarios.correction: Validate actual low-ball travel and arrival; avoid adult crossing distance or automatic heading.

scenarios.title: Separate from the other box target
scenarios.coordination: H_LW delivers; H_RW occupies near-post space in this scene; H_ST uses central space; H_CM stays at edge; H_DM balances.

source_sections.S10: Part 3 variations 2–3; Part 4 organization and variation

scenarios.cue: teammate occupies near-post space; a reachable central zone remains open.
scenarios.preferred_decision: offer the distinct central target.
scenarios.acceptable_alternative: change route if a defender closes it.
scenarios.coach_feedback: “Different runs gave different options.”
scenarios.correction: No requirement to fill all four box zones with four runners; only named teammates occupy them.
